newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Berlin, N.J..

text.p: to be held Thursday, April 17, 1997, for
Interest Payment Dates: April 15 and October 15, commencing October 15,
Denominations: $5,000 and integral multiples thereof Call Feature: Bonds maturing on and after April 15, 2008,
on and after April 15, 2007, in whole or in
part, at par Bank Qualified: Designated as
purposes of Internal Revenue Code Section
Maturity Principal Maturity Principal Maturity Principal (April 15) Amount (April 15) Amount (April 15) Amount
Submission. Sealed bids by 11:00 a.m., April 17, 1997, at Municipal Building, not less than $2,215,000 nor more than $1,000 cash premium in excess thereof, plus accrued
interest, specifying amount of Bonds the bidder will accept (the Bonds accepted to be the first to mature). Interest Rates. Either single rate for all Bonds or

individual rate for each maturity, expressed in multiples of 1/8 or 1/20 of 1%, ascending only. Form of Proposal. Only on prescribed Form of Proposal and in accordance with Official Invitation, each included within Preliminary Official Statement. Bid Security. $44,300, certified, bank cashier's or
treasurer's check, payable to Township, to be applied toward

purchase of Bonds or retained as liquidated damage bidder defaults. Basis of Award. Lowest net interest cost (total interest dollars to be paid over the life of the Bonds, less any premium). Additional Terms and Conditions of Sale. Set forth in Official Invitation, which shall be controlling in the event of any inconsistency herewith. The Township reserves the rights to waive any minor errors or irregularities in form or content of any proposal and to reject all proposals.

Compliance with SEC Rule 15c2-12. Preliminary Official Statement, dated April 9, 1997, deemed final in accordance with SEC Rule 15c2-12. Final Official Statements to be provided as required, subject to timely receipt of

information from successful bidder. Continuing Disclosure undertaking by Township, as required by Rule 15c2-12. Insurance. At bidder's option and expense, if qualified. Delivery of Bonds. On or about April 30, 1997, subject to, inter alia, receipt from successful bidder of reoffering prices of and yield on the Bonds, and approval of legality of issuance thereof by Blank Rome Comisky & McCauley, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, and Cherry Hill, New Jersey, Bond Counsel.
Copies of the Official Invitation and Preliminary Official Statement may be obtained from Lori Campisano, Chief
Financial Officer, Berlin Township Municipal Building, 170 Bate Avenue, West Berlin, New Jersey 08091. Phone: (609) 768-1230.
